publicationStatus: review proposals; not adopted and not publicly generated
scope: Five new proposals T346–T350 plus the 217 main article provenance entries carried forward from release.v11.json.
sourceMethod: Read NICENESS official product-page descriptions and product/material labels; keep brand references, design intent and predicted aging attributed to the brand. No historical, user-experience, performance, pricing, availability or brand-history claim is added.

duplicateReservationCheck.result: GitHub issue searches for each ID and each selected product model returned zero matches on 2026-10-04.

topicIndexCheck.includes: main, PR14–PR20 proposal topics; proposed T346–T350 intentionally kept out of this baseline snapshot.

independentReview.conclusion: All five proposals pass editorial/source-to-claim review. The 250-topic overlap index and candidate screen were reviewed; no direct ID/model duplicates found, and noted adjacent topics are distinguished.
findings: All facts are supported by NICENESS official product pages; seasons absent from two pages are explicitly marked as not stated.
T349 body and sleeve lining compositions were separated and rechecked against the official materials listing; PASS.

claims.statement: NICENESS describes 150-count hand-spun and hand-woven khadi and a boxy silhouette referring to 1950s US vintage shirts.
The check interval is 5 × 7 cm, its lines are 4 mm wide, and NICENESS says it expresses the lines by pulling threads one at a time by hand.
The composition is 100% cotton and the country-of-manufacture label says India.

articles.boundary: 格子の寸法、糸を抜く方法、生地とシルエットはNICENESSの商品説明に記された仕様・参照として紹介する。どの方向の糸を何本抜くか、工程順や処理方法、参照元となった特定の古着は確認していない。
articles.overlapScreen: Distinct from T002 (kasuri jacket) and PR20 T344 (warp/weft dobby stripe); focus is measured hand-pulled lattice on this khadi shirt.

claims.statement: NICENESS describes the low-volume triangle shape and its intended relation to wrapping and ornament.
The apple motif is expressed on a 28-gauge computer jacquard machine; the yarn is described as Südwolle 15.5 micron Super160s wool and as shrink-resistant finished.
The material label says 100% wool and the country-of-manufacture label says Japan.

articles.boundary: 三角形のフォルム、リンゴ柄の製法、糸の規格、防縮仕上げは公式の商品説明に帰属させる。図案の由来、具体的な編み目構造や加工条件、独立した着用評価は確認していない。
articles.overlapScreen: Distinct from T041 (scarf motif) and T015 (cap brim); focus is the apple jacquard and triangle form of this scarf.

claims.statement: NICENESS cites snow-camouflage military garments as the design reference, without identifying a specific uniform or period.
The product uses a light cashmere tweed made with cashmere yarn spun while incorporating air; the outer fabric is twill.
The shell is 100% cashmere, the lining is 70% cotton and 30% silk, and the country-of-manufacture label says Japan; the page does not state a season.

articles.overlapScreen: Avoids T099 (Frisco history) and PR20 T344 (weaving); focus is current cashmere-yarn/twill/lining construction. Season not stated.

claims.statement: NICENESS cites 1930s–40s USAAF/aviator jackets as a design reference and says the current design adopts denim-jacket construction.
The calf leather is tanned in India and dyed and wax-finished at a factory in Japan; this does not establish rawhide origin or individual operators.

The material listing identifies calf leather shell, body lining of 63% polyester/35% rayon/2% polyurethane, sleeve lining of 60% polyester/40% cupro, and 89% wool/10% nylon/1% polyurethane rib, with Japan as country of manufacture.

articles.overlapScreen: Distinct from T110 (British riding-jacket/GEOFF) and T323 (sports-jacket record); focus is the current leather-treatment route and the brand’s A2/denim-construction explanation.

claims.statement: NICENESS describes minimizing cutting to retain the expression of a single hide and identifies UK lamb leather and Italian merino lining mouton.
The product page predicts that wear may crack the grain and reveal the brown base; this is a brand statement, not an observed user outcome or durability test.
The material listing identifies mouton leather for the body and lamb leather and cowhide for some parts, with Japan as country of manufacture; the page does not state a season.
